limitations: Original early models did not save F count or computed weights; reconstructed baseline may differ from the originally frozen model due to unavailable detail.
This is uncalibrated heuristic, not tactical 1M simulation; head_scenario_hypothesis labels are for visualization only.
Previously finished races are RESEARCH replay, not genuine forward predictions. New forecast files do not overwrite old fixed picks.
Pre-cutoff timestamp labels apply only relative to this research record's generation and must be checked against repository commit time.
Venues without racing today are not forecast; 14/24 today.
Weather is original pre-cutoff snapshot weather; no current near-race observation is assumed.
